title: Onboarding Labs: dashboard tour hero screens and annotated callouts for observability
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a set of onboarding/quickstart UX visual assets that showcase the Observability dashboards in the Console. Primary focus is on three hero flows: 1) Latency heatmap + distribution snapshot, 2) Cost-per-token sparklines and token breakdown card, and 3) Tracing waterfall with grouped spans and prefix/KV cache hit overlay. Deliverables should support documentation, in-console first-run tour, and marketing one-pagers.
acceptance_criteria: Hero screens for Latency, Cost-per-token, and Trace views exported at 2x (PNG) and SVG for responsive use
Each hero image has an annotated overlay version (callouts) and a clean version for thumbnails
In-console guided-tour frames produced as a sequence of 6 steps with copy and arrow positions documented
Accessibility check completed: contrast ratios, readable type sizes, and alt-text for each asset
File delivery in Figma (link below) and a production-ready folder in Drive with naming convention: onboarding/observability/<asset>_v1.png
